integrity: The proof rests on the standard published weighted-autocorrelation denominator, with new monotonicity and phase analysis proved explicitly. Exact finite checks from standalone standard-library code do not certify the infinite claim. No independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: All-parameter theorem only for the two specified equal-measure binary Bernoulli cylinders of lengths 2k+2, k>=3; the previously published k=2 example is credited. No ranking of other holes or all-pattern crossover uniqueness is claimed. Priority relative to undiscovered literature remains provisional.
title: A logarithmic-bias phase law for equal-measure Bernoulli cylinder holes
